comments.author: The Musical Soldier
comments.body_html: Just out of curiosity, what are the tracks used throughout this mod?

comments.author: SiulSC
comments.body_html: Look up “Nicknine NFS THE RUN OST” and you should see the garage music, I also included unreleased ones that aren’t on his channel (Got them from ripping the game files).

comments.author: The Musical Soldier
comments.body_html:
Oh, so it’s all just the music from the Run and not the other games (not that I’m complaining, NFS The Run has some class music.)

Tho by any chance could I suggest a games sound track to be added to EFT (I have no clue on how to make these music mods)

comments.author: SiulSC
comments.body_html:
I added NFS Rivals Hideout music and added some custom tracks from NFS Score (Not the same as the Game OST).

If you want to make your own music mod, you have to download the plugin and add the music you want.

It took me a lot of time to extract NFS The Run game files, as well as Rivals.

comments.author: SiulSC
comments.body_html: No, music is incomplete and with loads of YouTube compression. MP3 from Wav file is not the same as MP3 from YouTube video.
